description: This script processes JUnit XML test reports, parses test cases, and renders test results with color output, supporting both file and directory inputs.

methods.name: parse_junit_reports
methods.description: Parses JUnit XML reports from a file or directory, returning a list of test cases.

methods.name: convert_junit_to_testcases
methods.description: Converts JUnitXml or TestSuite objects into a list of individual TestCase objects.

methods.name: render_tests
methods.description: Displays test results with color coding, indicating passed, failed, and skipped tests.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for report path input.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the report parsing and rendering based on CLI input.
